description:
FILED s465 (Fable, 2026-09-02) from the USER decision on docs/plan-test-audit-s464.md Â§5.3 ("Wholesale from 5.40.3, re-bless row by row").  Runs AFTER phase 0 (the instruments, agent AZ s465) so the re-bless has the cause column (I3) and the shortfall column (I2) to write into.

THE 35 FILES (measured s465, byte compare against /home/bernt/perl5/perlbrew/build/perl-5.40.3/perl-5.40.3/t, the t/op/ copy preferred when a basename exists in several dirs; local lines vs upstream lines):
  local SHORTER = upstream growth, refresh is a copy: while.t 33 vs 223, lex.t 251 vs 400, warn.t 142 vs 242, die.t 85 vs 126, index.t 307 vs 369, concat.t 821 vs 863, cond.t 17 vs 31, anonsub.t 123 vs 125, closure.t 818 vs 815 (LONGER by 3: check), ref.t 929 vs 936, undef.t 209 vs 210, eval.t 770 vs 770 (same length, differs: read the diff), kvaslice.t 201 vs 194 (longer), pos.t 164 vs 161, split.t 768 vs 765, sprintf.t 775 vs 773, sprintf2.t 1234 vs 1231, substr.t 924 vs 921, negate.t 114 vs 113, my.t 177 vs 174, lc.t 451 vs 449, exists_sub.t 85 vs 83, chr.t 97 vs 92, hash.t 289 vs 285, for.t 777 vs 775, bop.t 706 vs 704, signatures.t 1742 vs 1730, range.t 481 vs 472, pack.t 2085 vs 2050
  local LONGER = PCL edits to SEPARATE first (they are the principle-9 comment-outs, inline SKIPs, or harness lines): state.t 616 vs 567, each.t 371 vs 330, bless.t 255 vs 236, vec.t 275 vs 261, cmpchain.t 183 vs 175, method.t 772 vs 760
  no upstream counterpart (leave): errno_test.t, min_local.t, parent.t
  (a small local surplus of 1-3 lines in the "shorter" group is usually the perl-tests/ header or an inline SKIP -- read every diff, do not assume)

METHOD, per file: `diff` local vs upstream; classify every local-only hunk: (a) principle-9 comment-out of INVALID perl (keep, and LIST it in baselines/perl-tests-local-edits.tsv: file, upstream line, reason); (b) inline ok(1,'SKIP') or skip "not supported in PCL" (DROP -- rule 5; the assertion returns; if it fails, registry or fix per the runbook); (c) a harness edit (t/test.pl path etc. -- keep if still needed, list it); (d) anything else = a PCL edit with no record -> restore upstream and see what fails.  Then copy upstream, re-apply (a)+(c), run the sweep on THAT file alone, and edit both baselines row by row with a cause per row (I3 column).  A file that goes PARTIAL or TRANSPILE_FAIL after the refresh is a FINDING (file it), never a reason to keep the old copy.

ALSO IN THIS PHASE (review Â§5, docs/blessed-fails-review-s464.md): re-probe and retire the not-supported entry "Runtime $ENV{TZ} changes not reflected in localtime" (time.t is 72/72 with its TZ skip restored); re-point "Context propagation into string eval"'s Affected-tests line away from the kvhslice.t rows that diverge with no eval (#1023); kvhslice.t's planned/produced hole (39/38) gets its I2 cause.

BARS: the sweep after every file (TOTAL/LOST read), the two baselines edited row by row (never re-blessed from a run), the gate; the file count of perl-tests/ unchanged (108); the local-edits list complete (every local-only hunk accounted for).
RELATED: #965 (the inline SKIPs -- absorbed here; state.t's 46 wait on #1037), #993, #1037.
